title: KYCAMLEnvelope
description: JSON Schema for the OpenKYCAML KYC/AML Envelope carried inside the ISO 20022 <SplmtryData><Envlp> element. PlcAndNm discriminator: 'OpenKYCAML/KYCAMLEnvelope/1.0'.

envelopeVersion.description: Version of the KYCAMLEnvelope schema. Used by parsers to select the correct deserialiser.

messageRef.description: The ISO 20022 GrpHdr/MsgId value of the enclosing message. Links the envelope back to the payment message for audit purposes.

openKycAmlVersion.description: The version of the OpenKYCAML core schema used to construct this envelope (e.g. '1.3.0').

kycProfile.description: The full or partial kycProfile block from the originator's OpenKYCAML payload. May be omitted for minimal Travel Rule messages; required for CDD reliance payloads.

overallRiskRating.description: Overall AML risk classification assigned by the sending institution.

ratingDate.description: Date the risk rating was last assessed (ISO 8601 date).

dueDiligenceType.description: Level of due diligence performed (Simplified / Standard / Enhanced).

customerClassification.description: Customer classification used for AML risk profiling (e.g. RETAIL, CORPORATE, VASP, HNW).

kycCompletionDate.description: Date the KYC process was completed (ISO 8601 date).

onboardingChannel.description: Channel through which the customer was onboarded (e.g. IN_PERSON, REMOTE_VIDEO, EUDI_WALLET).

thirdPartyCDDReliance.description: Third-party CDD reliance record (AMLR Art. 48). Populated when the sending institution relies on CDD performed by a third party.

beneficialOwnership.description: Ultimate Beneficial Owners (AMLR Art. 26). Array of UBO records.

screeningResults.description: Consolidated screening results: sanctions, PEP, and adverse media checks performed on the originating party at the time of the payment.

screeningDate.description: Date the sanctions screening was last performed.

listsScreened.description: List identifiers screened (e.g. OFAC_SDN, EU_CONSOLIDATED, UN_CONSOLIDATED, HMT_CONSOLIDATED).

hitDetails.description: Human-readable description of any screening hit. Null when result is CLEAR.

isPEP.description: True if the originator is identified as a Politically Exposed Person.

pepRole.description: Public role or position if isPEP is true.

hitSummary.description: Brief summary of adverse media findings. Null when CLEAR.

consentRecord.description: GDPR Art. 6/7 consent record for the processing of personal data in this payment message.

consentGiven.description: True if the data subject has given explicit consent for processing.

consentTimestamp.description: UTC timestamp when consent was recorded (ISO 8601).

consentPurpose.description: Purpose for which consent was obtained (e.g. 'AML_TRAVEL_RULE', 'THIRD_PARTY_CDD', 'ONGOING_MONITORING').

consentVersion.description: Version of the privacy notice / consent form presented to the data subject.

legalBasis.description: GDPR lawful basis code (e.g. 'GDPR-Art6-1c' for legal obligation, 'GDPR-Art6-1a' for consent).

withdrawalTimestamp.description: UTC timestamp if the data subject subsequently withdrew consent. Null if consent is still active.

vcProofs.description: Array of eIDAS 2.0 Verifiable Credential proof references. Each entry anchors the identity assertion to a DID-addressed credential.

issuerDid.description: DID of the credential issuer (e.g. national PID provider, KYC utility).

subjectDid.description: DID of the credential subject (user's EUDI Wallet).

verifierDid.description: DID of the relying party that verified the credential.

presentationDate.description: UTC timestamp when the credential was presented.

verificationMethod.description: DID URL of the verification key used to sign the credential.

proofValue.description: Base58- or Base64url-encoded proof value. Null for ZKP / selective disclosure credentials.

gdprSensitivityMetadata.description: GDPR/AML sensitivity classification block (mirrors OpenKYCAML v1.3.0 gdprSensitivityMetadata). MUST be preserved by all intermediaries. tippingOffProtected=true means the payload MUST NOT be logged or disclosed to the data subject.

restrictedFields.description: JSON Pointer paths (RFC 6901) to individual fields with elevated sensitivity.

tippingOffProtected.description: AMLR Art. 73 / FATF Rec. 21 flag. When true, this payload relates to a SAR/STR and MUST NOT be disclosed to the data subject or unauthorised parties.

legalBasis.description: Applicable legal basis for processing this payload (e.g. 'GDPR-Art6-1c', 'AMLR-Art73', 'GDPR-Art9-2g').

retentionPeriod.description: ISO 8601 duration for the mandatory retention period (e.g. 'P5Y' for 5 years per AMLR Art. 56).

auditReference.description: Opaque DPO/SAR case reference (hash or opaque ID — no case content).
